headline: Apple-affiliated preprint reports one compact vision-language model family across digital-agent tasks
summary: An Apple-affiliated September 2026 preprint describes MintAct, a family of 2B, 4B and 8B vision-language models trained to combine screenshot-based UI grounding, multi-step mobile/desktop/web navigation and visual tool use. The authors use staged supervised learning, per-domain reinforcement-learning specialists distilled into one model, and asynchronous online RL with an explicitly controlled training mix. They report MintAct-8B scores of 48.9 on OSWorld-Verified, 74.7 on Weblica, 67.0 on AndroidWorld and 24.5 on MM-ToolSandBox, with many size-matched specialist comparisons favorable but not uniformly so. These are author-reported benchmark results without independent reproduction. The final joint-RL experiment covers mobile and desktop rather than all domains; the authors leave all-domain joint RL for future work, and no public model or code release was located in this review.
